contracts.commit_point: The external LLM invocation performed by the agent's model node — the model=get_model() binding handed to create_agent at app/rag/graph.py:233-239; the guard commits at the abefore_model hook by returning jump_to='end', which skips this invocation for GUARDRAIL-classified messages.
contracts.declared_mechanism: IntentMiddleware (AgentMiddleware subclass) declares an abefore_model pre-model hook decorated with @hook_config(can_jump_to=["end"]) (app/rag/graph.py:173-177). The hook reads state['pending_message'], classifies it via classify() (which returns Intent.GUARDRAIL on any _GUARDRAIL_PATTERNS match, classifier.py:93-95), and when the intent is GUARDRAIL (grouped with GREETING/OFF_TOPIC at lines 192-197) appends an AIMessage containing a canned refusal from reply_for(intent) and returns jump_to='end', terminating the run before the model node executes. IntentMiddleware is instantiated in build_agent()'s middleware list and passed to create_agent (graph.py:223-239), which is invoked during application startup in the FastAPI lifespan handler (app/main.py:24).
contracts.forbidden_condition: The agent's LLM model invocation executing on a message classified as Intent.GUARDRAIL — i.e., input matching a _GUARDRAIL_PATTERNS regex (e.g., r"system\s+prompt", r"ignore\s+(all\s+)?(previous|prior)\s+instructions?", r"reveal\s+(your|the)\s+(prompt|instructions)", r"jailbreak") reaching the external model call.

contracts.protected_operation: The agent's LLM model invocation (the model step of the create_agent graph, invoked with the conversation including state['pending_message']).
contracts.protected_resource: The external LLM model obtained via get_model() and bound into the agent at create_agent(model=get_model(), ...) in build_agent() (app/rag/graph.py:233-239).
contracts.protection_obligation: The production chat agent must not forward prompt-injection/jailbreak inputs to the LLM model invocation: when classify() labels the pending user message as Intent.GUARDRAIL (matched by _GUARDRAIL_PATTERNS such as 'ignore previous instructions' or 'reveal your system prompt', or via the prototype-similarity path), IntentMiddleware.abefore_model must short-circuit the agent run with a canned refusal (jump_to='end') so the manipulative input never reaches the agent's model node. (Merges the phase-one and phase-two reviewer wordings of the same obligation.)
scope_limits: Only inputs classified as Intent.GUARDRAIL are covered by this contract; the same hook also short-circuits GREETING and OFF_TOPIC intents with canned replies (graph.py:192-197), which are separate behaviors not claimed here.

Detection is regex-based over lowercased text plus an optional cosine-prototype path; paraphrased or obfuscated injection phrasing not matching _GUARDRAIL_PATTERNS and not scoring above the prototype threshold is outside the declared guard.
The guard operates inside the agent run lifecycle; HTTP-level /chat request handling is not itself evidenced because app/api/routes/chat.py was not supplied.
